messages:
ellie-cs: Heads-up — customer VastHealth hit regional throttles during a live demo and asked for a temporary throughput bump + IP allowlist for EU and APAC while onboarding finishes. Case created (789312). They want this window for 72h starting ASAP.

jared-ops: Case link? exact requested QPS per region?

ellie-cs: Case #789312 — requests: EU -> 5000 qps (currently ~1200), APAC -> 2000 qps (currently ~800). Duration 72h, auto-revoke after window. They provided exit IP ranges: 34.210.0.0/18 and 3.5.120.0/22. Also asked that we route to eu-west and apac-sg edges.

maria-net: I can add L7 allowlist entries for those CIDRs. Do we need network-level peering or ASN info? If this is persistent we should open a peering ticket.

ellie-cs: L7 only for now (fastest). No ASN/NAT details. Please set TTL so entries auto-revoke in 72h. Add comment to case: "auto-revoke in 72h (2024-10-05T14:00:00Z)".

sanjay-eng: Which model route are they using? Recommend fallback policy pinned to a smaller quantized variant and KV cache warmup during the burst.

ellie-cs: Route: vh-chat-prod -> redwood/llama-2-70b-chat-q4 (quantized). Customer accepts fallback to redwood/llama-2-13b-chat-q4 if needed.

kevin-ml: Quick perf tip: cap per-request max_tokens to 512 for the burst window, enable prefix caching for the known demo prompts. That should reduce downstream tail latency.

ops-bot: Ticket 789312-allowlist created by ellie-cs. Assigned: maria-net. SLA: 4h.

maria-net: Adding L7 rules now. Plan: create ephemeral rule with TTL=259200s (72h), tag routes 'region=eu,apac', and map CIDRs to eu-west/apac-sg edge pools. Applying in ~2m.

jared-ops: After apply — please run a quick smoke test and paste a curl example we can share with the customer. Example we usually use:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"route":"vh-chat-prod","input":"health check","max_tokens":10}'
```

maria-net: Done — rules applied and tagged. Verified a 200 response from a test IP 34.210.12.45 hitting eu gateway. Auto-revoke scheduled.

sanjay-eng: Ran a small synthetic load test: p50 ~85ms, p95 ~320ms under target burst. No queueing observed in redispatch. Will keep monitoring.

ellie-cs: Thanks all :raised_hands: I'll notify VastHealth that the bump and allowlist are live, confirm the demo flow, and schedule a short enablement session. Note: their enterprise renewal is in 29 days — smooth onboarding here is high impact.

jared-ops: Added a Renewal Watch flag to case 789312 and CC'd the CS lead + sales rep.

ellie-cs: I'll update the case with the smoke test output and close the loop with sales.
